# Offline scenario fixtures

These YAML and HTML files exercise parsing, fixture staging, artifact verification,
resume and runtime-bundle contracts. Template identifiers are deliberately fictitious.
They are not a public live-deployment catalog and do not establish cloud acceptance.

Runnable project examples live in [examples](../../../examples/README.md). Keep retained
regression cases even when their original experiment wrappers are removed: their task
shape can still expose failures in generic infrastructure. New fixtures should use
small synthetic inputs and generic names, without account IDs, credentials or dated
production aliases.
